TRIGGER.label: Trigger
TRIGGER.description: Starts the workflow when a specific event is received.

SEND_EMAIL.label: Send Email
SEND_EMAIL.description: Sends an email to the contact using a template you choose.

DELAY.label: Delay
DELAY.description: Pauses the workflow for a set amount of time before continuing.

WAIT_FOR_EVENT.label: Wait for Event
WAIT_FOR_EVENT.description: Waits until the contact triggers a specific event, then continues.

CONDITION.label: Condition
CONDITION.description: Splits the flow based on contact data — each path leads to different steps.

EXIT.label: Exit
EXIT.description: Ends the workflow for the contact.

WEBHOOK.label: Webhook
WEBHOOK.description: Makes an HTTP request to an external URL with the contact's data.

UPDATE_CONTACT.label: Update Contact
UPDATE_CONTACT.description: Sets or updates fields on the contact's profile.
